Continuous deployment of a vector control intervention

Source: R/xml_export.R
om_continuous.Rd

Builds a continuous schedule for deploy_OM_vector_control and get_OM_xml: the intervention is given to people when they reach a target age (e.g. nets through EPI or antenatal care, or at school entry), with a coverage, while the deployment is active (OpenMalaria <continuous> deployment). Unlike campaigns (om_campaigns), it cannot target an age range at given dates: use campaigns with minAge / maxAge for that. A net deployed both continuously and by campaigns is deployed twice under the same name (two deployments of the same components).

Standard (non dummy-host) interventions only; cumulative, minAge and maxAge of the deploy do not apply, subpop does.

Usage

om_continuous(age, coverage, begin = NULL, end = NULL)

Arguments

age

Target ages in years (0 to 100), numbers or placeholders (e.g. "@ageITN@"); one deploy per age.

coverage

Coverage at each target age: a number in [0, 1] or a placeholder (e.g. "@contITNcov@"), one value or one per age.

begin, end

Optional dates ("YYYY-MM-DD") between which the deployment is active (OpenMalaria's defaults: from the start of the intervention period, without end), one value or one per age.

Value

A data frame of class om_continuous, one row per target age (targetAgeYrs, coverage, begin, end).

See also

om_campaigns, deploy_OM_vector_control

Examples

# Nets to infants at 3 months (EPI), from 2021, coverage as a placeholder
om_continuous(age = 0.25, coverage = "@contITNcov@", begin = "2021-01-01")
#>   targetAgeYrs     coverage      begin  end
#> 1         0.25 @contITNcov@ 2021-01-01 <NA>
# Two channels with their own coverage
om_continuous(age = c(0.25, 6), coverage = c(0.8, 0.6),
              begin = "2021-01-01", end = "2030-01-01")
#>   targetAgeYrs coverage      begin        end
#> 1         0.25      0.8 2021-01-01 2030-01-01
#> 2            6      0.6 2021-01-01 2030-01-01
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
baseList = deploy_OM_vector_control(baseList, "IG2",
    om_continuous(age = 0.25, coverage = 0.8, begin = "2021-01-01"))
} # }
